critique.evidence: Reduced motion is correctly honored at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Tablet and mobile timing is acceptable overall (16.87–17.28 ms average, 0 long frames), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, every measured midpoint is effectively identical to the endpoint—opacity about 0.45 and the same matrix3d/−30 px transform—so the evidence does not demonstrate smooth interpolation between the initial and final states.
critique.fix: Make the transition visibly interpolate through distinct intermediate opacity and transform values, then recapture start/mid/end while the animation is active. Optimize desktop rendering toward a ≤16.7 ms average and reduce the 50 ms spike, while preserving the proven reduced-motion override.
